You are a repo fix worker. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the OBE podcast repo (/mnt/d_drive/repos/podcast) at HEAD — edit files here directly.

OWNERSHIP BOUNDARY: you own exactly two paths: scripts/obe_escalation_card.py and tests/test_obe_escalation_card.py (a new file). Nothing else — do NOT touch scripts/obe_tg_notify.py, scripts/run_podcast_loop.sh, or any existing test. Never touch .git, never commit, never run git add; leave changes uncommitted. The harness stages every change and FAILS on anything outside your two owned paths.

CONTEXT: scripts/obe_escalation_card.py creates a Linear card for a podcast loop escalation (via /home/ankit114/scripts/linear_control_ticket.py) and buzzes the owner's phone with Approve/Respond buttons. PROVEN DEFECT (read-only audit, 2026-08-05): it records the created card NOWHERE, so the hourly mailroom re-arm job (loop-factory factory/reescalate.py, reading /home/ankit114/.config/loop-factory/card_ledger.jsonl) never sees these cards — an unanswered card buzzes exactly once and is unreachable after the 72h button nonce dies. The mailroom's re-arm selection has NO department/kind gating: any ledger row with a row_hash, status 'open', a non-empty card_identifier, and a first_raised timestamp is re-armed on cadence. The fix is therefore: append one well-formed row to that ledger as soon as the card identifier exists.

CHANGE: after the Linear card identifier is successfully obtained — and regardless of whether the subsequent Telegram buzz succeeds (a ledgered card with a failed buzz will be re-armed later, which converts a lost buzz from a permanent loss into a delay) — append ONE JSON line to the ledger. Ledger path: default /home/ankit114/.config/loop-factory/card_ledger.jsonl, overridable via an environment variable OBE_CARD_LEDGER (tests use this; also lets ops relocate it). Row shape must mirror the mailroom writer exactly; here is a real mailroom-written row for reference (from the live ledger):
{"card_identifier": "ANK-312", "card_url": "https://linear.app/...", "department": "outreach", "first_raised": "2026-08-05T17:36:10.084268+00:00", "kind": "escalation", "packet_text": "...", "row_hash": "7d858ac3...", "status": "open", "summary": "[outreach] needs you: ...", "ts": "2026-08-05T17:36:10.084268+00:00"}
For this script: department 'podcast', kind 'escalation', status 'open', first_raised and ts = now UTC isoformat, summary = the card title truncated to 80 chars, packet_text = the escalation text (truncate to a sane bound, e.g. 2000 chars), card_url when the ticket tool returns one, row_hash = sha256 hex over a stable serialization of the identifying content (loop + escalate-file content hash + card_identifier is fine — it must be unique per card and stable if the same card were re-processed). Append with a single os-level append write of one line (open mode 'a', single write call) so concurrent writers cannot interleave. A ledger-append failure must NOT kill the buzz: log it to the existing failure-log mechanism (see how scripts/obe_tg_notify.py logs to logs/tg-notify-failures.jsonl — you may import and reuse its _log_failure via the module, since you may not edit that file) or fall back to printing to stderr, then continue; but the process exit code must be nonzero if the ledger write failed so the caller's fallback path notices (inspect how scripts/run_podcast_loop.sh interprets this script's exit code READ-ONLY and keep that contract: exit 0 currently means card+buzz delivered).

DECISION ALREADY MADE for you (owner-approved design): ledger write failure => still attempt the buzz, then exit nonzero. Card-creation failure => unchanged behavior from today.

TESTS: new tests/test_obe_escalation_card.py in the repo's existing test style, stubbing the ticket tool and transport (no network, no ssh, no real ledger path — use OBE_CARD_LEDGER pointing into tmp_path): (a) successful card creation appends exactly one row containing row_hash, card_identifier, department podcast, kind escalation, status open, and a parseable first_raised — i.e. every field the re-arm selector needs; (b) buzz failure still leaves the ledger row written; (c) ledger-append failure (e.g. unwritable path) still buzzes but exits nonzero; (d) the row is valid JSON on one line.

HOW TO RUN (from the worktree root — all must pass): PLACEHOLDER_MODE=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest tests/test_obe_escalation_card.py tests/test_tg_approval.py tests/test_obe_tg_notify.py -q -p no:cacheprovider && python3 -m py_compile scripts/obe_escalation_card.py

HARD RULES: no new dependencies, minimal diff, no reformatting of untouched lines, tests stub every external effect, never invoke any network, model CLI, MCP, or skill, and leave changes uncommitted — the harness exports the diff.
